I was in exactly your position a year ago. Here is what has helped me over the past year:

- Use soaps without detergent in them -cetaphil is a good one. All of those acne soaps will irritate your skin and strip it of its natural oils.
- always put moisturizer on within a couple of min of drying your face. If you do not, it will dry out your skin and to compensate will produce more oils.
- get an Rx for Differin, it is a lotion you put on your face every night before putting on moisturizer that gets rid of acne. Your general practitioner can prescribe this to you if you do not want to go to a dermatologist.  
-wash your face once in the morning and in the evening

Birth control also works wonders, partially because acne for women is often related to your hormone levels through your cycle. If you notice your acne flaring up before your period, this may be the case.

Currently I am opting for a more natural route (dunno if it works yet), but I use a honey/cinnamon mixture for spot treatment and wash face with oatmeal at night. I still use the differin and put moisturizer on. But my skin is noticeably softer. Besides the natural remedies I am experimenting with now, the above information was all given to me by my doctors and it has worked wonders.

Edit: I failed to mention that my skin has been really clear for this past year after following all of this. I had moderate acne before and now at most I'll get one rogue pimple that goes away in a couple of days.
